content.short: FusionX is a native Mantle DeFi ecosystem centered on AMM trading, liquidity, and yield opportunities.
content.description: FusionX is a native DeFi ecosystem on Mantle that combines an automated market maker with broader trading and earning tools. Its documentation describes FusionX as a leading Mantle DEX focused on high liquidity, efficient swaps, and user-friendly access to DeFi services. The platform is built to help users trade tokens, provide liquidity, and participate in Mantle-based yield activity while benefiting from the network's lower transaction costs. FusionX is best understood as a core liquidity venue for traders and liquidity providers in the Mantle ecosystem.
